messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Fixed reduced motion for card border transitions and the win banner. With reduced motion enabled, both now appear without animation; normal motion remains unchanged.

The build, typecheck, 138 unit tests and both focused motion browser tests passed. The full browser suite passed 74 of 76 checks; the face-sheet and repeated score-persistence checks timed out. The format check also reported issues in 13 unrelated, untouched files.
